failure_patterns.pattern: cache_write_omission: Search or filter results were returned without being saved as new cache entries.

rejected_edits.content: Perform an independent action only when the current turn expressly requests it or supplies missing inputs for a still-pending request, and only when its required inputs are complete; do not repeat completed work merely because that domain was requested earlier.
rejected_edits.target: Still perform every independent requested search or update whose own required inputs are complete in the same turn.

rejected_edits.content: When the user answers an optional refinement question or accepts an offer to provide recommendations, and a compatible cached result already covers the active request, retrieve the most relevant applicable result with `get_results_from_cache` so it can be used in the response. Do not return “No planning needed” solely because no new search or filter is required; do not modify the result unless the user supplies new criteria.
rejected_edits.target: Use “No planning needed” only when compatible cached results satisfy every current request without further action.
